display.purpose: Page titles and section H2s. Barlow Condensed, applied automatically to h1/h2.

title.purpose: Card and subsection headings. Manrope (h3 and below).

label.purpose: Short uppercase gold section eyebrows and metadata.

shadows.name: button-hover
shadows.purpose: Warm amber-tinted lift under gold buttons.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for hovers, reveals, and state transitions.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Symmetric motion such as the hero float animation.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single high-intent action. Earthen gold with deep forest text; lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-gold { background: oklch(79% 0.148 84); color: oklch(27% 0.09 146); font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px; padding: 14px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-gold:hover { background: oklch(63% 0.128 66); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 14px 28px rgba(80,58,10,0.14); } .ds-btn-gold:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(53% 0.115 65); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-gold:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action on dark green sections. Translucent white border, inverse text.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: oklch(98.5% 0.005 146); font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px; padding: 14px 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.28); border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); border-color: oklch(98.5% 0.005 146); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Near-white content card with the signature 18px radius; flat at rest, lifts on hover.
components.html:
Own Farming

Vertically integrated cultivation across our estates.
components.css: .ds-card { background: oklch(99.5% 0.004 130); color: oklch(19% 0.042 146); border: 1px solid oklch(91% 0.02 107); border-radius: 18px; padding: 28px; box-shadow: 0 16px 30px rgba(42,58,42,0.07); transition: transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), box-shadow 240ms ease, border-color 240ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 24px 40px rgba(42,58,42,0.12); } .ds-card h3 { font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 12px; color: oklch(34% 0.094 146); } .ds-card p { font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0; line-height: 1.625; color: oklch(44% 0.025 153); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Top-nav link with an animated gold underline that grows from the left on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; color: oklch(27% 0.038 146); transition: color 180ms ease; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: -0.45rem; width: 100%; height: 2px; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(63% 0.128 66); transform: scaleX(0.35); transform-origin: left center; opacity: 0; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), opacity 220ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { color: oklch(34% 0.094 146); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible::after { transform: scaleX(1); opacity: 1; }

components.name: Proof Chip
components.description: Pill-shaped proof point for dark green sections; translucent fill, 44px touch target.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; border-radius: 999px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: oklch(92% 0.012 146); font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: 0.01em; }

components.name: Section Eyebrow
components.description: Short uppercase gold label that sits directly above a section heading.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1.2px; color: oklch(53% 0.115 65); }

narrative.overview: GreenEarth Agro is a Ghana-based agro-processing company that competes internationally, and the design system carries that exact tension: global-grade industrial rigor rooted unmistakably in West African soil. The surface is built from deep forest greens and a warm cream-to-sage neutral family, with amber gold reserved for the moments that ask for action. Structure is the message: clean hierarchy, deliberate pacing, and generous breathing room are how a B2B buyer or investor reads operational competence before they read a single claim. The system is calm but never cold; warmth comes from the landscape and from soft, green-tinted elevation rather than hard drop shadows. It is progressive without being sterile: scientific confidence and forward momentum, not minimalist chill.
keyCharacteristics: Forest-green authority with a warm cream/sage neutral base
Amber gold as a rare, high-intent accent (CTAs only)
Condensed display type for scale, humanist sans for reading
Soft, green-tinted elevation; flat at rest, lifts on interaction
Automatic light/dark theme via prefers-color-scheme and a manual data-theme override

rules.name: The One Action Color Rule
rules.body: Amber gold is for things you click: primary buttons, nav-hover underlines, and short uppercase eyebrows. It never fills a panel, never tints a background, never becomes decoration.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral leans green (chroma 0.004-0.05 around hue 130-155). #000 and #fff are forbidden. A gray that reads as truly neutral is a bug.

rules.name: The On-Dark Rule
rules.body: On the always-dark-green sections (hero, contact, footer), text uses only text-on-dark / heading-on-dark. Never drop a light-surface text token onto a dark green panel.

rules.name: The Condensed-Heading Rule
rules.body: h1 and h2 are always Barlow Condensed; h3 and below are always Manrope. This split is the typographic signature.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Section eyebrows are short, uppercase, gold, letter-spaced ~1.2px, and sit directly above their heading. They label; they never form sentences.

rules.name: The Lift-on-Intent Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Elevation increases only on hover/focus, always accompanied by a small upward translate (-1px buttons, -4px cards).

rules.name: The Green-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are tinted toward the brand (greenish rgba(42,58,42,...), or warm rgba(80,58,10,...) under gold). A neutral-black shadow is a bug.

dos: Do use the agro-* design tokens for every color, never literal hex/oklch in components.
Do keep amber gold for actions and eyebrows only (The One Action Color Rule).
Do set h1/h2 in Barlow Condensed and everything smaller in Manrope.
Do tint every neutral toward the brand green; cream and sage, never flat gray.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest and lift them on hover/focus with a small translate and a green-tinted shadow.
Do prove claims with specifics (tonnage, farmer count, regions, capacity) placed near every headline.
Do use text-on-dark / heading-on-dark on the hero, contact, and footer bands.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion and meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast.
donts: Don't ship generic SaaS/startup cream: white backgrounds, Inter, pale blue-green gradients, or floating blob shapes.
Don't use farm-kitsch (barn illustrations, rustic wood textures, tractor icons) that undercuts industrial scale.
Don't build cluttered toolbar-heavy enterprise-GIS layouts or dense dark-mode data walls.
Don't use #000 or #fff, or any untinted gray text.
Don't let gold fill a background or become decoration.
Don't use border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't apply hard neutral-black drop shadows; shadows are soft and green/amber-tinted.
Don't use em dashes in copy.
